caption: United pizza and two beers at O’Hare, jet on the glass. Home day, still a couple of time zones short of California.
Economy Plus duck faces. Cabin EXIT light for a halo.
Blue winglet under a split sky at Palm Beach. Storm left, sun right — Caribbean trip packing up.
Chili’s at PBI — Southwestern eggrolls and a burger with fries. Airport fuel before the next leg.
West Bay Street, in the water. Nassau doing the color it advertised.
Tacos and a lime soda at John Watling’s Distillery. Plantains in the tortilla, patio mesh table.
Red upper story, Bahamian flag, Union Jack. Nassau city tour, late morning light.
Queen’s Staircase, limestone cut, Bahamian flag in the gorge. Nassau city tour, not subtle.
Bahamas Rum Cake Factory on Bay Street. Mandatory stop, city-tour pacing.
Welcome to the Cayman Islands, coat of arms and all. Port building, then the water.
Cayman Boat Adventures console sticker, turquoise water, condos on the beach. Snorkel day.
Out with the snorkel boat, mangroves on the shore. Grand Cayman, still close to land.
Full profile of the Lady at the Cayman anchorage. Not a boat-interior shot — just the ship from the water.
Brilliant Lady from the tender off George Town. Bow on, red letters, Cayman water.
Tender into George Town. Ship in the sunglasses, North Church Street ahead.
Ocho Rios cruise terminal. Brilliant Lady on the hook, pier in the foreground.
Shuttle back from Bamboo Beach. Whole van accounted for.
Us at the Bamboo Beach sign. White sails, lounge chairs, the easy part of the Shore Thing day.
Bamboo Beach Club, 2026 already on the board. Greetings from Jamaica, conch shells in the planters.
Same river, still smiling. Turquoise water that looks like it belongs on a postcard, not a tube run.
On the bank before the float. Helmets, green tubes, Jamaica heat.
White River tubing, Shore Thing. Green tube, blue vest, bamboo on the bank.
Ocho Rios turtle sign at Island Village. Flags, wires, the usual Caribbean skyline of utilities.
San Alberto iced coffee and a slice of chocolate cake. God bless great coffee, says the coaster.
Siphon brew at Café San Alberto. Purple apron, blue flame, coffee as a science project.
Wrought-iron sconce inside the cathedral. Six candles, colonial hardware.
Cartagena Cathedral, pink dome, stone that holds the heat. Plaza selfie.
La Cevicheria, empty plate, lobster on the rim. San Diego, waiting on the first course.
Sandwich and paprika fries in Centro. Club Colombia still in the corner of the frame.
Club Colombia Dorada in the walled city. Condensation doing the advertising.
The whole fort from the lawn. Blas de Lezo’s hill, tourists for scale.
Castillo San Felipe de Barajas. Hot, huge, the Spanish flag still on the wall.
Eagle Beach, blue tablecloths under the palapas, jet skis in the cut. End of the Aruba loop.
Tuna tartare and burrata on the same table. Passions doing both coasts of the menu.
Steak, fries, salad on a tortilla at Passions on the Beach. Eagle Beach lunch after the drive.
Same lighthouse, closer. Hudishibana, coconut stand somewhere behind us.
California Lighthouse, Noord. White stone, no clouds, end of the island.
De Palm catamaran off Malmok. Tour boats on the calm side after a morning of dirt roads.
Surf hitting the black rock on the Natural Pool trail. Fence in the dirt, Atlantic doing the rest.
Windward coast toward the natural pool. Volcanic rock, white water, turbines on the ridge.
Arubajeeprent.com on the door, dust on the fender. This is the island the resorts don’t show.
Arikok track from the hood of the Jeep. Two concrete ribbons, cactus on the ridge.
Boca Prins cove. Wind, kelp, a little beach the ocean is trying to take back.
Fontein Cave. Stalactites, a marked path, a break from the sun.
Baby Beach palapa and that ridiculous turquoise. San Nicolaas end of the island.
Chemis mural on Marktstraat: Love the life you live, on a high-voltage box. Savaneta, not the postcard strip.
Savaneta shoreline. Mangroves in the shallows, water going from milk to blue.
Jeep keys in Oranjestad. Top on, AC up, island day.
Oranjestad from the rental lot. Pink Dutch gables, a mural, too many parked cars.
Bayside squall from under the eaves. Palms sideways, the kind of rain that shuts a plaza down.
Hard Rock burger at Bayside before we boarded. Flag in the bun, fries with actual pepper.
Sanguich de Miami. The cheese pull is the whole review.
Two Hard Rock cups at the end of the Key West loop. Cold beer, Key West on the shirt behind them.
Pirate on the bench at Shipwreck Treasures. He had the better hat.
The Red Doors, 1827, Caroline and William. White house, red shutters, Key West doing the postcard.
Conch fritters and a cheeseburger, blender cup standing in as tableware. Key West, takeout boxes.
The Wandering Rooster Citroën on turf. Smash burgers, Cuban mix, conch fritters — and a live rooster.
Booze in the Blender cup, peach slush, parrot on the plastic. Key West Margaritaville souvenir whether you want it or not.
Cuban flatbread on Duval — ham, pork, pickles, mustard drizzle. Lunch that made sense.
Salt rim and a chili on Duval. Margaritaville Key West, Jimmy on the wall, Happy Gilmore on the TV.
Looking up at the Hard Rock’s gingerbread. The sign is almost secondary.
Hard Rock Cafe, 313 Duval. Victorian gingerbread, blue paint, Key West heat.
Marlin on the sign at Garrison Bight. Key West City Marina, charter boat row.
Old Seven Mile Bridge with trees growing on the deck. Nature keeping the railroad.
US 1 over water at Marathon. The old span running parallel the whole way.
Channel 2 Bridge, Islamorada. New road, old arches, people fishing the gap.
Key West Express+ bus in Key Largo. Top deck, Van Hool, day trip officially started.
Key Largo stop on the way down. Sun hat, sidewalk, Overseas Highway glare.
Bomboloni with lemon and pistachio cream. Same bakery, harder choice.
Cannoli and cream puffs in the case near Brickell. Italian pastry after a Cuban afternoon.
Thin-crust pizza back in Brickell after Calle Ocho. White drizzle, herbs, no leftovers.
Burrata and tomatoes at Mary Brickell Village. Bread in a paper bag with a whole rosemary sprig.
Welcome to Calle 8, mural edition. Sala’O on the wall, Little Havana in neon paint.
Calle Ocho rooster on the sidewalk. Heart on the chest, patio behind it.
Man-sized moka pot and Celia Cruz on the orange wall. La Colada’s idea of décor.
The red roaster at La Colada. Freshly roasted at home, bags stacked behind it.
Whipped cream architecture at La Colada Gourmet. Espresso on a Cuba saucer.
Calle 8 mosaic in Little Havana. Dominoes, fruit, and the neighborhood name in tile.
Domino Park, Little Havana. The tables were full; we stayed at the arch.
Live band at Old’s Havana. Fedora, guitar, Coca-Cola lamps, Bacardi on the wall.
Palomilla, moros, maduros. Old’s Havana does the Cuban plate the way you want it.
Two mojitos at Old’s Havana, cane garnish, mint lined up for the next round.
Calle Ocho tile mural — guitar, maracas, flags in the letters. Bello ’18.
Guarapo in a foam cup, cane stick for a stirrer. Little Havana sidewalk fuel.
Sugarcane through the press on Calle Ocho. Loud machine, sweet juice.
The Octopus Building on NW 36th. Mosaic tentacles, clay tile roof, no irony.
Royal palms in a grid at Maurice A. Ferré Park. Sign in the corner, sky doing the rest.
Zaha Hadid’s One Thousand Museum from the street. The exoskeleton is the whole point.
Freedom Tower holding its own against the glass boxes. Miami Dade banners on the yellow stone.
El Loro at Pier 5, Bayside. Red pirate hull, Miami skyline behind it. Big Bus day.
Wave sculpture at Maurice A. Ferré Park — dolphin, turtle, manatee in one foam curl.
Eggs, greens, and a couple slices of ham on toast. Same breakfast table.
Waffles, berries, too much syrup. Fuel before the Big Bus loop.
From the window: BRICKELL in lights, Saks downstairs, traffic still moving.
Moon over Brickell, two palms doing the framing. Hotel-neighborhood night.
Looking up at Brickell from the sidewalk. Palms, white towers, still warm out.
The whole table at Crazy About You — ribs, fish, wine. Paper liner spells it out.
Seared fish and a little potato gratin. The quieter plate on the Crazy About You table.
The ribs at Crazy About You came under a pile of onion straws. Dry ice on the tray for show.
Honey, pistachios, and a slab of cheese. Crazy About You does not do small appetizers.
Tostones with tomato at Crazy About You. First plate of the trip, still in Brickell.
First night in Brickell. The bay, the high-rises, a little boat cutting the reflections.
Shake Shack at DEN. Two burgers, crinkle fries, layover doing what layovers do.
United on the tarmac at Hollywood Burbank, stairs in the sun. BUR to DEN the old-fashioned way — walk outside and climb.
Guy Fieri’s Kitchen + Bar Express at BUR. Breakfast burrito and beer in plastic — first flight asked for it.
Simi Valley station at first light. Green shelters, yellow edge, tracks bending out toward the rest of the day.
Simi Valley platform, Pacific Surfliner timetable as the alibi. First move of the long way to Miami.
Gangway selfie in Virgin red. Brilliant Lady ahead — Caribbean, unlocked.
First hours onboard under the ceramic wall art. Already smiling like the itinerary knows what it’s doing.
Red hammock, Hard Rock shirt, zero agenda. Sea Terrace working as designed.
Scalp inspection with a Miami skyline. The cabin doorway left a calling card.
Ship wake, pure abstract. The Lady churning indigo on the way out.
A loo with a view. Deep blue horizon from the most honest window on the ship.
Chrome tunnel into Pink Agave. The neon does the inviting; we do the walking.
The Diva Goes West — cactus cutouts, pink cowboy hat, rubber chicken in the wings.
Four adults, one Santorini puzzle, two frozen drinks. Master puzzlers at sea.
Life-size board game in the Roundabout. Ship’s wheel spinner, seahorse poles, V-Voyages running the show.
Rainbow tulle under purple lights. Drag night on Brilliant Lady doing what it does best.
Meet-and-greet with the rainbow gown. Red feather optional; fabulous mandatory.
Scarlet Night from above the Roundabout. Giant tentacles, pink light, everyone in red.
Friendship-bracelet board: cut, fold, shape 4. Craft hour with paint-splattered proof.
Pink Virgin Voyages screens, seats filling. Waiting for the house lights to drop.
Pool-deck kiss under the red funnel. Rainbow lights, night air, still at sea.
Matching The Band bracelets and a Ventura bag. Holding hands on the way off — or on.
Sea Terrace, red hammock on the balcony. Home for eleven nights, already made.
Close-up of the scalp scrape. Caribbean souvenir number one, and we hadn’t even left the channel.
Hammock selfie, Virgin V on the tag. Balcony therapy, day one.
Another ship steaming the Miami channel. We watch from Brilliant Lady as the skyline slides by.
South Beach towers at dusk from the channel. Pilot boat wake, Magic City fading astern.
Twilight shore from the ship — striped tower, palm, a kite over the cut.
The Manor before the show. Two poles, red-blue light, front-row sandals in the frame.
Sun on the horizon, gold path on the water. At-sea sunset from the Lady’s deck.
Cabin bed with the red Virgin runner. Laptop open, daylight through the sheer curtains.
Acrobats in full scarlet. Human pyramid under red light while the Roundabout watches.
Scarlet Night pyramid, tentacle in the corner. Seeing red in the best way.
Inflatable octopus owns the stage. Pearls on the floor, lasers in the haze.
Chia pudding on the balcony rail, coast on the horizon. Breakfast with a roll.
Margaritaville on the hull, turtle lanyards on. Palm Beach boarding bridge.
The mandatory giant flip-flop. Margaritaville at Sea, before we even sailed.
Nothin' But a Breeze over the porthole. Cabin unlocked.
Two cold cups, Margaritaville stamped on both. Ship-brand hydration.
Porthole seat, floral dress, Nothin' But a Breeze. Best chair on the ship.
Cheek kiss on deck under a stacked sky. Margaritaville evening.
RESCUE tug through the porthole. Palm Beach homecoming.
Hot Pie Pizza in West Palm — thin crust and hot wings. Between Virgin and Margaritaville.
Julia against the coral flower wall. Nassau doing the tropical backdrop.
The Pizza Place on Brilliant Lady — egg pie with cracked pepper, pepperoni with roasted garlic, another egg with basil. Ship pizza run.
Extra Virgin wine tasting — flights lined up, bread on the side.
Rice Rice Baby sushi-making class — setup, rolling, finished trays.
Pull-apart rolls still steaming, then the corn bowl, then the crudo. The Wake, Night 1 starters.
Seared steak and three lamb chops — roasted garlic, watercress, The Wake doing steakhouse right.
Chocolate hazelnut tart with a sail, then berries in a bronze bowl. The Wake saved dessert for last.
Citrus fennel salad with pomegranate and pistachio, then chilled shrimp with cocktail sauce. The Wake breakfast starters.
Steak and eggs with spinach and hash brown, then eggs Benedict under hollandaise. The Wake brunch plates.
Octopus on puree with pork-and-cheese toasts, then jamón with almonds on black. Rojo starters, Night 2.
Fish fillet with artichokes and grilled lemon, then sliced steak with red relish and charred onion. Rojo mains.
Basque-style cheesecake with raspberry coulis, then churros in chocolate sauce. Rojo desserts to close Night 2.
Orange soup with a quenelle in a rock-rim bowl, mushroom-shaped mousse, then an egg yolk ringed with peas. Test Kitchen Menu A.
Green puree with asparagus ribbons, scallops and cured-meat ribbons in a rock bowl, then steak on magenta sauce with berries. Test Kitchen Menu A mains.
Twin chocolate-topped bars with red coulis, then a chocolate dome with white sponge and red currants. Test Kitchen Menu A desserts.
Passions on the Beach — frozen drinks and a deck selfie.
Julia under the wooden mermaid. Cartagena lunch stop.
